jobs.description: The 주소DB (도로명주소 ↔ 지번, rtlDtaDtlSn 8) from the provider's public download screen API of business.juso.go.kr, with no login and no key (root ADR-0495; scripts/ops/juso-address-db-cycle.sh). With no base in its state directory the run lands the newest monthly full once (jusogokr__address_db_monthly_full, 181 MB on 2026-11-11); then, from its cursor (the next day to land, starting at the base's first day so one month is replayed onto it) to yesterday in KST, it asks one list per month and lands each day's change file oldest first (jusogokr__address_db_daily_change), byte for byte, each committed on its own; the cursor moves past a day only after its file is committed, and a day the list does not hold is passed only once a later day has landed. The object is named by the provider's stored file name, so landing a file twice is the committer's idempotent success. The per-run cap is the contract's per_run_cap: 62 day files and 1 GB. A failure fails the run so the unit's OnFailure raises the alert; what landed stays and the next run goes on from the cursor.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the 2026-11-11 measurement: the 181,440,694-byte monthly full downloaded in 49 s, 41 day files of 1 to 100 KB and three month lists at the contract's 3 s spacing (about 135 s), and one R2 write of the full at the measured 50 MB/s of the data.go.kr file collector (about 4 s); 600 s is about three times that sum and a sixth of the 3,600 s limit. A run after the first is one list and one day file, about 10 s. The first run is the measurement (root ADR-0457 §3)

expected_outcome.basis: the provider publishes a change file for every day (61 of 61 days listed on 2026-11-11 for 2026-09..10); two daily turns.

assets.title: 주소DB 매일 받기
assets.description: 제공처의 공개 내려받기 화면 API(business.juso.go.kr, 로그인·키 없음)로 주소DB 월전체를 한 번 기초로 받고, 그 달 첫날부터 어제(KST)까지 날마다의 일변동 파일을 오래된 것부터 Bronze(jusogokr__address_db_monthly_full, jusogokr__address_db_daily_change)에 그대로 남긴다. 파일마다 커밋한 뒤에만 커서를 옮긴다(루트 ADR-0495).

assets.title: 주소DB
assets.description: 주소기반산업지원서비스의 주소DB(구 매칭데이터): 도로명주소(도로명코드·건물번호)와 그 대표·관련 지번(법정동 코드·산·본번·부번), 월전체와 일변동. 도로명 주소만 가진 원천(경매·공매)을 공식 지번에 놓는 원장이다(루트 ADR-0495). 받은 객체가 아직 0 이고 Silver 가 없어 planned 다.
